brief: Holds one rule about an organisation chart, a stzGraphRule that belongs to the orgchart domain.
detail: The four universal rules of stzOrgRuleSet are stzOrgRule objects: no-self-report, no-cyclic-reporting, no-orphan-position and span-of-control. Build one yourself with a name, set its severity, message and checker like any stzGraphRule, and add it to a stzOrgRuleSet or to a compliance base.
